topics.title: Diversity in Plants and Animals Around Us

concepts.learning_objective: Observe and record the features of plants and animals around us without disturbing them.
Explain biodiversity as the variety of living things in a region and how plants and animals depend on each other.
Explain why grouping living things by similarities and differences makes them easier to study.
Identify and apply a common feature as the basis for grouping plants and animals.

topics.title: Herbs, Shrubs, Trees, Climbers and Creepers

concepts.learning_objective: Classify plants as herbs, shrubs or trees by height, nature of stem and branching.
Distinguish climbers and creepers as plants with weak stems.
Distinguish reticulate and parallel venation in leaves.
Distinguish taproots and fibrous roots and relate them to leaf venation.
Group plants as monocots or dicots by the number of cotyledons and relate this to roots and venation.
Identify the types of movement in animals and the body parts they use.

topics.title: Plants and Animals in Different Surroundings: Adaptations

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how features of desert and mountain plants help them survive their surroundings.
Explain how the features of camels in hot and cold deserts help them survive.
Define habitat and group living things as terrestrial, aquatic or amphibians.
Explain how habitat damage causes loss of biodiversity and how it can be protected.
